name: Cornish Hen
siboNotes: Plain Cornish hen is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated for SIBO. Avoid marinades or seasonings containing garlic, onion, or high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Roast with low-FODMAP vegetables like carrots and parsnips
Remove skin if fat sensitivity is a concern for SIBO
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially niacin and B6
Good source of phosphorus and selenium
